summary: Verizon ABS II LLC filed a Form 8-K reporting that Verizon Master Trust issued asset-backed notes on September 22, 2026: approximately $826.0 million Class A-1a, $65.0 million Class A-1b, $68.1 million Class B, and $40.9 million Class C notes, totaling roughly $1.0 billion. The notes were described in a final prospectus dated September 15, 2026, with U.S. Bank Trust Company as indenture trustee and U.S. Bank National Association as financial institution. The filing includes executed Indenture and Account Control Agreement exhibits. This is a routine ABS takedown, not a special situation; monitor credit enhancement and performance of the underlying receivables.
